old_value: {"id":"JMAP-i61u","title":"Commit a group send in one transaction","description":"chinwag (chinwag-dxgx.28) runs SQLite with synchronous=NORMAL: a power cut or OS crash can lose the last few seconds of committed messages. synchronous=FULL makes group bursts about 3x slower, because a group send makes one backend write per recipient and each write is its own commit. If jmap-chat-server's backend trait let one group send (the Message plus its per-member deliveries) be written as one unit, a backend could commit it once, and chinwag could run FULL at roughly today's speed. Mark chose (2026-10-30): keep NORMAL in chinwag now, and file this here.","status":"open","priority":3,"issue_type":"feature","owner":"mark@reviewcommit.com","created_at":"2026-10-31T02:59:05.591558902Z","created_by":"agent","updated_at":"2026-10-31T02:59:05.591558902Z","dependencies":[{"issue_id":"JMAP-i61u","depends_on_id":"JMAP-z4z0.5","type":"supersedes","created_at":"2026-10-31T18:48:57.106373611Z","created_by":"agent","metadata":"{}"}]}
